set.body:
Reuses the existing provider-adoption ticket; this operative scope replaces its stale August baseline and fleet-authority language. Current baseline is Atlas 77297769/provider pin 774fb1e8. Archived 245-test/link qualification exists; no final-pin browser run is asserted. Wider static bundle production remains bd-01M19JQRMYBTYJN7V9HPN7DYKQ.

Point 3 integration gate. External prerequisite (StoryModel store): bd-01M34JAX5KKWECCY72KD4ZV0BW after G1 bd-01M2WVENSB0P955Y0B603CC20Y and support bd-01M19956MFSG7076QE4J66T7E9. Status is blocked while that package is unavailable. This is a real local adoption task, not a foreign dependency edge or automatic reflection of upstream status.

Entry and acceptance:
1. Inspect the exact reachable producer commit and its manifest/join, fixed-cut matrix, evidence/subset APIs, schemas, generator and independent expected answers. A plan, fixture-shaped handwritten JSON or closed upstream issue alone does not satisfy entry.
2. Once those artifacts exist, set this issue open and run the consumer gate. Pin storymodel4sRevision to that exact SHA; record actual dependency overrides and reachability. Do not rename a legacy voyage as a checked workspace or reference measurement.
3. Add external-consumer decode/compile courts for both generated fixtures. Wrong identities, unsupported schema, dropped failure rows, changed digests, denied content and numeric/measure conflations fail before rendering. Preserve integer coordinates exactly and typed missingness.
4. Preserve existing source edition, draft and Voyage consumers; add no view-side scientific inference. Retain the original typed output adoption responsibilities where needed by the producer boundary; static publication remains separately tracked and cannot block the dynamic M1 loader.
5. Close with the exact compatible pair, generated-artifact digests and consumer evidence; record that this unlocks the local loader, not completion of M1.

Evidence: exact producer/consumer/Intaglio/grakern revisions, actual overrides distinguished from declared pins; compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS; existing shell smoke and tests implemented for the current slice; the complete M1 browser journey is required only by the final acceptance ticket. Provider adoption may close after decode/compile, exact-pin build and existing-consumer regression checks while loader, interaction and export remain unimplemented. Preserve warnings as findings and make changed code warning-clean. Browser automation uses the project browser, ownership audits before/after, and closes owned processes. Add a discriminating failure injection for each new boundary. Preserve static no-JavaScript publication as a separate contract. Test names for new M1 courts are specifications until implemented; never claim them run from ticket creation.
